title: Seated Cable Row
summary: Seated cable row: upper back 1, lats 0.8. A steady horizontal pull with any load.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: seated cable row station or cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Rhomboids and mid traps squeeze the shoulder blades together.
The lats pull the upper arm back, especially with a close neutral grip.
The elbow flexors bend the elbows (0.5).
Rear delts help pull the arm back; more with flared elbows.

setup.text: Feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Close neutral handle for more lats; wide bar for more upper back.

form_cues.cue: Sit tall with a neutral spine
form_cues.why: Torso staying upright stops a swing.

form_cues.cue: Pull the handle to your stomach
form_cues.why: Elbows toward the hips is the lat's line.

form_cues.cue: Let your shoulders reach forward on the return
form_cues.why: Reaching forward lets the shoulder blades open for the stretch.

form_cues.cue: Pause with the handle at your stomach
form_cues.why: That's the shortest point; easy to cut short.

bias_tweaks.effect: More upper back and rear delts.
More range of motion per side.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Rocking far back and forth to move the stack.
mistakes.fix: Keep the torso still; lighten the load if you lean back.
Use a load you can row with the torso still.

misconceptions.myth: Machines don't build muscle like free weights.
misconceptions.reality: Free-weight and machine training gave similar muscle growth in a meta-analysis. Pick by fit, stability and how well you can push close to failure.

lower_risk.text: The app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the first working load is at least 40 kg (95 lb) and the main muscle is not already warm from an earlier lift. Otherwise start with a slightly lighter first set.

Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2.5 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 3 reps in reserve in the 8-12 rep range. Easy to push close to failure.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: One arm at a time with a dumbbell.
Lying barbell row; heavier, no lower back.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

notes: Row variations have not been compared for growth in a study the app cites.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
